drawings.description: le reste de la page, tenue tête-bêche, barré de deux longs traits obliques : une roue de huit catégories de foncteurs ($\underline{\mathrm{Hom}}(A^{\wedge}, B^{\wedge})$ et ses variantes) reliées par des flèches le long d'un cercle, premier état de la roue de la page 5 ; au-dessous, un graphe de triangles aux sommets marqués $A^{\wedge}$, $B^{\wedge}$ et variantes.
drawings.kind: wheel of functor categories and a graph of triangles, wholly struck
drawings.notes: Wholly struck on the page: the wheel and the graph under it are crossed by two long oblique strokes that cancel this part of the sheet (the sheet is a printer listing, used upside down). Struck material is not drawn, so the redraw is empty; the record is kept so that the figure can be retired or omitted. What can be seen under the strokes: eight categories of the form Hom(A^, B^) with decorations (i, !!, Ens) placed around a pencilled circle and joined by arrows along it, one of them heavy; inside the circle, faint pencil chords with small labels; below, a faint pencil graph of adjacent triangles whose vertices carry labels of the form A^, B^, A^B^. The transcription's note calls it a first state of the wheel of p. 5. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
